core_rules.reason: Current Wave B semantic snapshot covers faction CSV semantics; it does not contain the global Wahapedia Core Rules prose corpus.

interpretation.EXACT_TOKEN_SEQUENCE_MATCH: Strong public overlap after conservative HTML/punctuation/whitespace canonicalization.
interpretation.HIGH_OVERLAP_NORMALIZATION_MATCH: High shingle overlap with exact anchor; likely PDF layout/normalization differences.
interpretation.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_REVIEW: Some official overlap exists but text is not sufficiently aligned for equivalence.
interpretation.REVIEW_REQUIRED_POSSIBLE_DRIFT_OR_LAYOUT: Exact source provenance and anchor exist, but low text overlap. Manual review must distinguish real drift from PDF extraction/layout effects.
interpretation.UNMAPPED_EXACT_SOURCE_REVIEW: Exact Faction Pack source provenance exists but no reliable official anchor/text match was found.
interpretation.TITLE_ONLY_PUBLIC_SCOPE_CANDIDATE: Faction-scoped row title occurs in the pack but text overlap is weak; source provenance is not exact.
interpretation.OUTSIDE_PUBLIC_PACK_OR_UNMAPPED: Faction-scoped candidate is not evidenced by this public pack and must not be treated as drift.
